title: Prismarine Shard Repairs Trident
description: This little mod makes the trident repairable with prismarine shards!
body:
# The "Prismarine Shard Repairs Trident" mod

Hey there!

Have you ever wanted a mod that has probably been made before but i'm too lazy to look?

...

i dont know what else to put so lets just get on with it


Say hello to the mod(ification) Prismarine Shard Repairs Trident! This mod adds a recipe with just 2 prismarine shards and a trident to make the trident you already have! (its still good just wait a sec)


3 Things to clarify before you hopefully download this
 
1. The recipe goes like this: (prismarine shard), (trident), (prismarine shard) in the top, bottom, or middle of a crafting table OR you can just look at the picture in the gallery.

2. Yes it has to be in a crafting table because I couldn't get it to work in an anvil (and frankly i think anvils breaking is annoying).

3. I have an suggestions/but report in the discord, just look for a channel named "mod-suggestions-or-bug-reports" and remember to include "Prismarine Shard Repairs Trident" in your suggestion/bug report! (but i'm sure you won't be needing that.. maybe)

Alright that should be it!

You're gonna download it now right?

Right?

...

oh dear.
